scope: read-only source review; report artifacts only
limitations: No assertion of actual CSC past-exam provenance.
Historical corrected/verified ledger statuses are not fresh verification.
Reading a question is not independent factual certification.
Static/test coverage is not semantic coverage.
No source edits, live Supabase access, dependencies, commits or pushes.

verification.meaning: Structural, correction snapshot, arithmetic and selected reasoning regression checks only.

findings.title: Region count is outdated
findings.evidence: RA 12000 established the Negros Island Region in June 2024; the keyed 17 omits that region.
findings.proposed_correction: Change key to 18 and date the question; update explanation to include NIR.

findings.title: National motto is confused with coat-of-arms scroll
findings.evidence: RA 8491 distinguishes the national motto in sec 40 from the scroll inscription REPUBLIKA NG PILIPINAS in sec 41.
findings.proposed_correction: Ask for the national motto under sec 40, or replace the choices and key with the scroll inscription.

findings.title: War declaration answer omits separate voting
findings.evidence: Article VI 23 (1) specifies two-thirds of both Houses in joint session voting separately.
findings.proposed_correction: Add voting separately to the keyed choice; retain the explanation.

findings.title: Salary grade alone does not establish exclusive jurisdiction
findings.evidence: RA 10660 sec 2 sets offense/office qualifications and includes an RTC proviso for specified cases not alleging damage/bribery or alleging at most P 1 million.
findings.proposed_correction: Specify an RA 3019 case within Sandiganbayan jurisdiction, with an SG 27 official and alleged government damage exceeding P 1 million. Keep the court key.

findings.title: Forty-percent foreign ownership cap needs agreement scope
findings.evidence: Article XII 2 also permits agreements with foreign-owned corporations for large-scale minerals/petroleum/mineral-oil development; LaBugal explains these FTAAs.
findings.proposed_correction: Limit the stem to corporations entering co-production, joint-venture or production-sharing agreements under Article XII 2; key 40%.

findings.title: SALN filing requirement has express exceptions
findings.evidence: RA 6713 sec 8 (A) excepts honorary officials, laborers, and casual or temporary workers. The stem and explanation both say all.
findings.proposed_correction: Ask what financial declaration covered officials must file; use the complete SALN title and mention statutory exceptions.

findings.title: Three readings on separate days is a general rule
findings.evidence: Article VI 26 (2) allows the presidential necessity certification exception for public calamity or emergency.
findings.proposed_correction: Add as a general rule to the stem and mention the certification exception in the explanation.

findings.title: Paris Agreement was adopted, not signed, in 2015
findings.evidence: The UN records adoption on 12 Dec 2015 and opening for signature on 22 Apr 2016.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace signed in 2015 with adopted in 2015. Keep Paris Agreement key.

findings.title: Senior-citizen discount explanation overstates covered goods
findings.evidence: RA 9994 sec 4 (a) enumerates covered goods/services; a general reference to medical and commercial goods can imply all retail purchases.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep law-title key. Say 20%discount and VAT exemption apply to enumerated qualifying goods/services for eligible resident Filipino seniors.

findings.title: Incineration ban is missing the statutory emissions qualification
findings.evidence: RA 8749 sec 20 describes the prohibited incineration as burning municipal, biomedical and hazardous wastes whose process emits poisonous and toxic fumes. The passage and answer present an absolute ban on all municipal-waste incinerators.
findings.proposed_correction: State the sec 20 qualification in passage, question and keyed choice.

findings.title: Balatkayo is incorrectly split
findings.evidence: The dictionary headword is balatkayo. The item repeatedly uses balat kayo.
findings.proposed_correction: Use balatkayo in stem and explanation. Retain the figurative meaning.

findings.title: Umaalingasaw is not generic rapid spreading
findings.evidence: The dictionary gives alingasaw as strong foul odor. The key adds an unsupported speed requirement and generic news-spreading.
findings.proposed_correction: Use naglalabas o kumakalat ang matapang at mabahong amoy; use a sentence if figurative news usage is intended.

findings.title: Choice itself labels the correct person as national hero
findings.evidence: The Rizal choice alone says Pambansang Bayani, directly answering the national-hero stem without knowing the name.
findings.proposed_correction: Remove all parenthetical biographical labels; ask directly for Rizal's complete name.

findings.title: Geographic annotations answer the directional question
findings.evidence: Eastern Border, Southern Border, Archipelagic Waters, and South China Sea annotations reveal elimination clues; two explicitly identify wrong directions.
findings.proposed_correction: Use parallel bare sea names; explain geography only after answering.

findings.title: Keyed answer is malformed
findings.evidence: The keyed expression labis na kapalmurahanan does not express the explanation's intended walang hiya clearly.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace with walang kahihiyan and make distractors parallel.

findings.title: Paragraph gives wrong divestment deadline
findings.evidence: Its sentence 1 says failure to divest within 30 days violates RA 6713. Section 9 distinguishes resignation from private-business position within 30 days from divestment within 60 days.
findings.proposed_correction: Change divestment period to 60 days; distinguish resignation deadline.

findings.title: Explanation misidentifies initial letter of upo
findings.evidence: Explanation says nakaupo joins without hyphen because the root starts with a consonant. Upo starts with vowel u.
findings.proposed_correction: Retain nakaupo key. Explain the applicable joining rule without calling u a consonant.

findings.title: Sentence contains laying instead of lying outside blank
findings.evidence: The document is laying on the desk has no object of lay. The desired stationary sense is lying. The blank correctly takes laid, but completing it does not repair the sentence.
findings.proposed_correction: Change initial clause to The document is lying on the desk right where you ___ it yesterday.

findings.title: Singular and plural possessives are both grammatical
findings.evidence: Both The employees' lounge and The employee's lounge are grammatical with different ownership. No stem specifies a shared room for multiple employees.
findings.proposed_correction: Specify that the lounge is shared by several employees, so only plural employees' satisfies the task.

findings.title: Woman's and women's are both possessive forms
findings.evidence: Both singular woman's auxiliary and plural women's auxiliary are syntactically valid. The question does not require a plural possessor.
findings.proposed_correction: Explicitly ask for the plural possessive of women.

findings.title: Definite article alternative is grammatical
findings.evidence: She is the honest public servant is grammatical when identifying a known person; the stem merely asks for correct articles.
findings.proposed_correction: Specify an indefinite noun phrase or remove the grammatical definite-article distractor.

findings.title: Courtesy convention is treated as grammar
findings.evidence: Both to me and Maria and to Maria and me use objective pronouns. Putting the other person first is a courtesy preference, not a grammatical requirement.
findings.proposed_correction: Ask for the conventional courteous ordering or replace the other grammatical option.

findings.title: Quantity of books is a valid count-noun construction
findings.evidence: Both a large number of books and a large quantity of books are grammatical; countability does not exclude quantity.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace quantity with an ungrammatical distractor or explicitly ask for the most idiomatic count expression.

findings.title: Explanation itself acknowledges both prepositions
findings.evidence: The explanation explicitly says oblivious to is also widely accepted; to and of are both listed choices.
findings.proposed_correction: Accept both only if multi-answer is supported, otherwise remove one grammatical alternative or contextualize a different construction.

findings.title: Than I is a valid elliptical comparison
findings.evidence: She likes him more than I can mean more than I do. She likes him more than me can mean more than she likes me. The question supplies neither intended comparison.
findings.proposed_correction: Specify that she likes him more than she likes me, or test full clauses.

findings.title: All listed pairs fit the stated tool-user relationship
findings.evidence: Scalpel:surgeon is matched by chisel:sculptor, hammer:carpenter, pen:author and needle:tailor. The explanation invents a specialized-cutting restriction absent from the stem.
findings.proposed_correction: State specialized cutting/carving-tool relationship or replace overlapping tool-user distractors.

findings.title: More than one material-creator analogy fits
findings.evidence: Canvas:painter as medium worked on also matches paper:writer and fabric:tailor as well as keyed marble:sculptor.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace competing material-user pairs with relations that do not fit, or sharpen the base relation.

findings.title: Instrument-reading relation fits several options
findings.evidence: Compass indicates direction, clock indicates time, ruler indicates length and scale indicates weight. The explanation supplies no criterion excluding the others.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace alternative measuring-instrument pairs or explicitly distinguish the intended relation.

findings.title: A direct antonym is present beside the keyed broader opposite
findings.evidence: Enfranchise grants rights, especially voting; disenfranchise removes them. Disenfranchise is an explicit choice, while key is Subjugate. The selected antonym relationship does not uniquely exclude the direct morphological opposite.
findings.proposed_correction: Rebuild this analogy so one answer uniquely fits; at minimum do not mark Disenfranchise wrong when asking for the opposite.

findings.title: Equivalent ratio distractor remains
findings.evidence: The dry and wet totals are 180 and 500. Both 9:25 and 18:50 equal 180:500; the stem does not require simplest form.
findings.proposed_correction: Add in simplest form, or replace 18:50 with a non-equivalent ratio.

findings.title: Total budget is absent from the standalone question
findings.evidence: Only allocation percentages are supplied. The keyed P 2 million depends on the P 10 million total present only in 3064, a separate record. Questions are independently selected.
findings.proposed_correction: Include total annual budget P 10 million in this record. The difference is 20%of that total.

findings.title: Calculated percentage does not match any listed answer
findings.evidence: 340/(120+340+200+80)*100=45.9459459%. It rounds to 46%at whole-percent precision. The key 45%is merely the nearest listed choice, not the computed percentage.
findings.proposed_correction: Use approximately 45.95%or 46%with explicit rounding. Alternatively ask which option is closest.

findings.title: Shared passage overstates incinerator prohibition
findings.evidence: The shared passage says RA 8749 prohibits the use of incinerators without the sec 20 poisonous/toxic-fume qualification. Comprehension answers repeat the inaccurate generalization.
findings.proposed_correction: Correct the shared passage; update 18014 answer wording as needed. Keep 18015 fund-purpose question if the passage is revised.

findings.title: Shared passage overstates incinerator prohibition
findings.evidence: The shared passage says RA 8749 prohibits the use of incinerators without the sec 20 poisonous/toxic-fume qualification. Comprehension answers repeat the inaccurate generalization.
findings.proposed_correction: Correct the shared passage; update 18014 answer wording as needed. Keep 18015 fund-purpose question if the passage is revised.

findings.title: Consent is presented as universally mandatory
findings.evidence: RA 10173 sec 12 permits several lawful processing bases in addition to consent, including contract and legal obligation. The passage says collecting organizations must obtain explicit consent.
findings.proposed_correction: Say processing requires a lawful basis, which may be consent, and appropriate security measures. Keep the privacy-purpose key.

findings.title: Shared passage falsely requires the CSE for every civil-service entrant
findings.evidence: CSC officially recognizes eligibility routes without the Career Service Examination, including honor-graduate and bar/board eligibility. The shared passage says a person must pass CSE to enter civil service.
findings.proposed_correction: Describe passing CSE as one route to eligibility. Rewrite 20191 to ask what route the passage describes; retain 20192 subject-coverage question with corrected passage.

findings.title: Shared passage falsely requires the CSE for every civil-service entrant
findings.evidence: CSC officially recognizes eligibility routes without the Career Service Examination, including honor-graduate and bar/board eligibility. The shared passage says a person must pass CSE to enter civil service.
findings.proposed_correction: Describe passing CSE as one route to eligibility. Rewrite 20191 to ask what route the passage describes; retain 20192 subject-coverage question with corrected passage.

findings.title: Keyed Filipino answer uses the wrong verb construction
findings.evidence: Maaari silang harapin ang mga kaso sa korte does not correctly express that they may face court cases.
findings.proposed_correction: Use Maaari silang maharap sa mga kaso sa korte; align the source passage.

findings.title: Tubbataha is misspelled throughout passage
findings.evidence: The passage and question repeatedly spell the park Tubataha or tubataha instead of Tubbataha.
findings.proposed_correction: Use Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park consistently.

findings.title: Textline dyeing is a typo
findings.evidence: Textline dyeing in the passage should be Textile dyeing.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace Textline with Textile.

findings.title: Singular their is a standard grammatical alternative
findings.evidence: Both Each of the students has his or her own laptop and Each of the students has their own laptop are grammatical. APA explicitly endorses singular their with each.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace the singular-their distractor or revise the task to test agreement using unambiguous errors.

unresolved_candidates.issue: Both umuunlad and progresibo plausibly overlap maunlad; provide a sentence and distinguish progressive/developed from developing.
Mabigat ang kamay is potentially polysemous; mahilig pumalo/malupit distractors may be defensible. Need authoritative idiom source and sentence context.
Magaan ang kamay may mean ready to strike rather than industrious; source and contextualize before accepting key.
Naglalagay ng bunga sa bibig is not established by the supplied explanation; needs dictionary or curriculum citation.
Mahabang dulang: keyed long process/hearing seems unsupported; idiomatic paglalagay sa mahabang dulang commonly concerns marriage. Need contextualized authoritative source.
Mahaba ang buhok keyed spiritual connection is unsupported. Require primary idiom source or replace with a documented expression.
Either I or II option can mean disjunction, which is exhaustive for contradictory some/no conclusions. Specify that the task evaluates each conclusion independently.
Same either/neither option ambiguity as 4007.
Same either/neither option ambiguity as 4007.
Same either/neither option ambiguity as 4007.
Incurs 10 absences is interpreted as at least 10. Explicit threshold wording would remove exact-count ambiguity.
The future sentence pupunta sa eskwela araw-araw can be grammatical for a future repeated plan. Add an explicit present-habit context.
More simple is acceptable alongside simpler in some standard uses; avoid universal two-syllable rule.
Supplementary to and complementary to both yield grammatical meaningful reports; intended relationship needs context.
Historic and historical are both grammatical treaty descriptions; specify historical importance.
Singular they and collective readings make third choice arguable; explanation conflicts with later 16047 use of their.
Different than/to vary across accepted English varieties; state the target convention instead of universal correctness.
Four budget phases are asserted, but the paragraph stops at authorization/signature and omits execution/accountability.
POLO terminology and DMW relationship need a current primary-source check; offices were renamed Migrant Workers Offices.
Current procurement framework needs RA 12009/repeal and transition context rather than implying RA 9184 is the sole current law.
Several collection-content pairs fit compendium:knowledge; keyed anthology:literature is not uniquely justified.
Brick:wall is most immediate, but house/foundation are also part-whole pairs. Sharpen relation.
Header says in thousands but options/explanation omit the unit. Distinguish 47,500 thousand from 47,500 passengers.
Combined team average may require ticket-volume weights; ask explicitly for unweighted mean of four team averages.
RA 9003 prohibits open burning of solid waste; passage says burning waste everywhere. Restore statutory scope before treating the passage as legal instruction.
Shares 20160 passage and its overbroad burning statement.
Blanket exclusion of hate speech from constitutional protection needs a precise statutory/jurisprudential basis and narrower wording.
Great Wall visibility from low Earth orbit is conditional and not a reliable unqualified fact; substantiate or remove it.
Sea turtles have species-specific diets; jellyfish are not the primary food of all sea-turtle species. Key matches text but passage needs qualification.
Ten minutes of mindfulness lowering cortisol is an unsourced precise medical claim; provide a suitable study or qualify.

pattern_findings.issue: All 50 questions 17051-17100 present sentences already in the exact keyed order A-B-C-D. Balanced answer positions do not remove this sentence-order shortcut.
pattern_findings.proposed_correction: Scramble sentence labels/order independently per item and update all order choices and keys consistently.

positive_rechecks.note: Eleven members confirmed by ASEAN; Timor-Leste admission26October2025.
Law number/short title remains consistent; not a newly found defect.

coverage_definition.semantic_read: Fresh first-pass reading of all four content elements; evaluated key plausibility, alternatives, explanation and cues. This is not a claim every external factual assertion was independently source-verified.
coverage_definition.targeted_primary_source: A specific claim was checked against the linked source, often because a defect was suspected. This does not certify every claim in that record.
coverage_definition.arithmetic: 75 PEMDAS stems recomputed by existing arithmetic parser during the 169 passing bank tests. Other mathematical stems and explanations received reviewer arithmetic/algebra reading; no new exhaustive proof harness was created.

static_bias.code_evidence: src/lib/questionSelection.ts:34-43 shuffles question arrays while preserving q.choices; src/routes/submission/[id]/+page.svelte:240 iterates question.choices directly. Parent separately verified the active attempt flow preserves choice order.

strongest.implication: Always choosing B scores90%in this bank.
First30records all place the key in A.
All50have keyed sentence order A-B-C-D, even when the answer choice position varies.

remaining_work: No IDs remain unread in this first pass. Independent external verification remains incomplete; see independent_verification_not_recorded_ids and unresolved_candidates. Resolve defects and ambiguous language with a qualified Filipino/English editor, then recheck corrected records.
